responsibility: Implements LONGINT and LONGCARD text I/O over channels using scanner-based tokenization and string-based formatting. It reads numbers by skipping spaces, driving WholeConv scanners, accumulating decimal values directly, and setting IOChan read results for format or range issues, while writes are delegated to StringConvert long integer/cardinal renderers and StringChan output helpers.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for LongWholeIO: it contains the actual LONGINT/LONGCARD channel parsing and string-formatting logic using WholeConv and StringConvert, whereas LongWholeIO.def only declares the procedures and their contracts.
